channel.title: Projects on Jared Goronkin
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Jared Goronkin

item.title: Generalized Physical Animation Without Kinematic Bodies
item.description: Fully physics-driven character animation system with no kinematic bodies or per-character retuning.

item.title: Herdspun Harvest, Lead Engineer (Contract)
item.description: Client-funded mobile game for Clean Cashmere via StarSouls Studio; prototype secured follow-on funding, demo shipped in 2 months.

item.title: Mosaic
item.description: Designed and engineered a Unity package featured at GDC 2025 for its ability to rapidly develop gameplay mechanics and systems. Leveraged by Echoes In The Mists.

item.title: Echoes in the Mists
item.description: Shown at GDC 2025 NYS Pavilion, I led engineering and production on this souls-like. Descend into a corrupted seaport where danger and discovery lurk around every corner. Powered by Mosaic.

item.title: Procedural Terrain
item.description: Built systems that let designers sculpt the final output, achieved overhangs without floating artifacts, and accelerated performance with compute shaders.

item.title: Data Structure Debug Library
item.description: A C++ debug and visualization tool developed to help students in SUNY Poly’s CS 240 course learn datastructures and algorithms.

item.title: Optimized Schooling Behavior
item.description: A boid simulation with obstacle avoidance, designer friendly pathing, and optimized for a game embeded in the web browser.

item.title: UI UX Systems
item.description: Over the years I’ve explored UX and UI design from both the technical and experiential sides, and now teach the subject in WVU’s graduate program. This section highlights a few of the systems I’ve built.
